title: Bank earnings live updates: JPMorgan, Wells Fargo, Goldman Sachs and Citigroup report Q3 2026
summary: JPMorgan Chase, Goldman Sachs, Wells Fargo and Citigroup all reported third-quarter 2026 results before the U.S. market open on Tuesday. Consensus estimates: JPMorgan ~$5.93 EPS on ~$51B revenue; Goldman ~$13 EPS on ~$16.8B revenue. Results kick off the Q3 earnings season and follow a quarter marked by elevated rates, AI investment spend, and dealmaking activity.
why: 四大银行Q3财报是评估美联储加息周期下信贷/投行健康度的关键指标，结果将直接影响本周市场情绪与风险偏好；期权卖方需留意JPM等银行股implied move 2–3%的单日波动区间。

title: 恒生指数早盘急跌后V型反转，收涨0.30%；恒生科技指数跌0.79%
summary: 恒生指数10月13日盘中快速回落后实现V型反转，收涨0.30%报24345.22点；恒生科技指数未能跟随大盘反弹，收跌0.79%，科技股与大盘出现明显分化，光通信概念股领跌。
why: 恒指企稳对港股整体持仓有支撑，但恒生科技持续弱于大盘，显示AI/科技板块面临额外估值压力；持有港股科技标的的sell put策略需留意方向性下行风险。

title: China's CXMT claims DRAM breakthrough, sparks global memory stock selloff; Micron drops 3.9%
summary: Chinese DRAM maker ChangXin Memory Technologies (CXMT) announced plans to launch server-grade DDR5 memory using a 4F² cell design before year-end, raising competitive concerns for incumbent memory makers. Micron Technology (MU) fell 3.9% on Monday October 12 as investors weighed the implications. Samsung and SK Hynix shares also declined sharply in Asian trading on October 13. The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index closed notably lower.
why: CXMT突破直接威胁持仓中SK海力士（HBM主力供应商）与美光(Micron)的竞争护城河及定价预期；存储股短期波动率上升，sell put策略的行权价缓冲需适当上调，应密切跟踪SK海力士港股ETF与MU的隐含波动率变化。

title: Hong Kong optical communications and PCB stocks extend losses; Cambridge Technology, YOFC fall over 5%
summary: Hong Kong-listed optical communications and PCB sector stocks continued to decline in morning trade on October 13. Cambridge Technology and YOFC (Yangtze Optical Fibre) fell over 5%; ZTE InnoLight dropped over 4%. The AI optical module supply chain remained under pressure amid broad semiconductor sector weakness.
why: 光通信板块是AI数据中心基础设施的核心赛道，持续下跌反映市场对AI资本开支持续性的担忧，间接影响英伟达、TSMC等AI算力相关持仓的估值预期。

title: Earnings season kicks into high gear as big banks report; September CPI data due Wednesday
summary: Q3 2026 earnings season is entering its most intense week: JPMorgan, Goldman Sachs, Wells Fargo, and Citigroup report Tuesday, with September CPI inflation data due Wednesday, October 14, at 8:30 a.m. ET. The Federal Reserve's next FOMC meeting is scheduled for October 27–28.
why: 财报季与通胀数据本周双重叠加：CPI若超预期将强化美联储10月加息预期，对当前卖出期权策略的delta风险和隐含波动率均有显著影响；美联储10月27-28日会议前市场不确定性将维持较高水平。

title: Tencent (00700) repurchased 237,000 shares for HK$100 million on October 13
summary: Tencent Holdings disclosed to the Hong Kong Stock Exchange that on October 13, 2026 it repurchased 237,000 shares at a cost of approximately HK$100 million. The company has continued its daily buyback programme at roughly this scale in recent weeks.
why: 腾讯每日约1亿港元的稳定回购为股价提供支撑，是sell put策略行权价参考的正向信号；本条仅报告本日单次回购数字，非累计数据。

title: Alibaba unveils AI glasses in expanding push into consumer hardware gadgets
summary: Alibaba launched a new AI-powered smart glasses product at an event in Hangzhou on October 13, expanding its Qwen AI ecosystem into consumer hardware. The product competes in the fast-growing AI glasses segment alongside Meta Ray-Ban glasses and other entrants.
why: 阿里持续拓展AI硬件端变现路径，通义千问生态扩张进入可穿戴设备；若市场将此定价为AI变现多元化的积极信号，有助于BABA估值重估，可留意港股9988与ADR的短期市场反应以评估sell put合适行权价。

title: Tesla faces U.S. safety probe over claims its Robotaxis speed in school zones
summary: The National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA) opened an evaluation on October 9 after receiving a petition alleging that Tesla Cybercab and Model Y vehicles operating under automated systems drive above speed limits in active school zones in Austin. The evaluation covers approximately 1,000 vehicles; no crashes or injuries were reported. NHTSA is assessing whether to escalate to a full investigation.
why: Robotaxi商业化进程面临新的监管变数，若NHTSA升级为正式调查，特斯拉FSD/Cybercab在奥斯汀的扩张计划可能受阻；TSLA短期承压，期权卖方需提升行权价安全边际。
